propositions: Whole-tree fixture helpers export all 3,019 checkout files when production hatch_build.py requires only three files, causing repeated full-package builds and 56–67% per-worker setup overhead across xdist workers.

Artifact-probe workflow builds with GITHUB_SHA from trusted-main instead of deriving git rev-parse --short HEAD after patchset checkout, causing exact-SHA validation to pass wrong nonempty provenances.

Production hatch_build.py on minimal committed Hatch package preserves env-override, git-fallback, blank-env, and sdist-preservation semantics while reducing paired build totals from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s.
Both _artifact-probe.yml workflow lanes must compute expected COMMIT from final checkout and require exact equality for wheel and installed sdist against that value.
All OS/Python matrix cells must execute real isolated PEP 517 sdist-to-wheel builds through copied production hatch_build.py without mocking or whole-checkout materialization.
